tasks.title: Complete TransformEngine Implementation
tasks.description: Implement all TransformEngine transforms in Rust backend: EnterInListItem, EnterInBlockQuote, EnterInHeading, and Wrap transforms. This is a blocking P0 issue - all transforms must be fully implemented in Rust with frontend wired to use them.
test_criteria: All TransformType enum variants have Rust implementations
EnterInListItem: empty item exits list and creates paragraph, content creates new item
EnterInBlockQuote: empty quote exits and creates paragraph, content continues quote
EnterInHeading: empty heading converts to paragraph, content creates same-level heading
Wrap transform wraps selection with before/after markers
cargo test passes for transform module
test_commands: npm run test --prefix www 2>/dev/null || echo 'Frontend tests not configured'

test_cases.name: EnterInListItem_empty_exits

test_cases.name: EnterInListItem_with_content
test_cases.description: Pressing Enter in a list item with content should create a new list item below

test_cases.name: EnterInListItem_nested
test_cases.description: Pressing Enter in a nested list item should maintain nesting
test_cases.expected_behavior:

  -

test_cases.name: EnterInBlockQuote_empty_exits
test_cases.description: Pressing Enter in an empty blockquote should exit and create paragraph

test_cases.name: EnterInBlockQuote_with_content
test_cases.description: Pressing Enter in a blockquote with content should continue the quote
test_cases.expected_behavior:
Continues quote on new line: `> Quote line
> 
`

test_cases.name: EnterInHeading_empty_converts
test_cases.description: Pressing Enter in an empty heading should convert to paragraph

test_cases.name: EnterInHeading_with_content
test_cases.description: Pressing Enter in a heading with content should create same-level heading

test_cases.name: EnterInHeading_setext_underline
test_cases.description: Pressing Enter after Setext heading underline should create paragraph

test_cases.name: Wrap_with_selection

test_cases.name: Wrap_nested_markers

test_cases.name: EndToEnd_EnterInList

tasks.title: Fix Undo/Redo Fidelity
tasks.description: Fix undo/redo implementation to ensure structural edits are atomic and state is preserved correctly across multiple undo/redo cycles. Add comprehensive round-trip tests.
test_criteria: Round-trip tests pass: do -> undo -> do -> undo = original state
Structural edits (lists, headings, blockquotes) undo correctly
No state corruption after multiple undo/redo cycles
Undo/redo works after save and reopen

test_cases.name: UndoRedo_roundtrip_list
test_cases.description: Add list item -> undo -> add again -> undo returns to original state

test_cases.name: UndoRedo_roundtrip_heading
test_cases.description: Change heading level -> undo -> change again -> original preserved

test_cases.name: UndoRedo_multiple_cycles
test_cases.description: 10 consecutive undo/redo cycles should not corrupt state

test_cases.name: UndoRedo_structural_edit_atomic
test_cases.description: Structural edits like list->blockquote are atomic
test_cases.expected_behavior: Undo converts back to list, not intermediate state

test_cases.name: UndoRedo_after_save_reload
test_cases.description: Undo/redo works correctly after save and document reopen
test_cases.expected_behavior: Undo works same as before save

test_cases.name: UndoRedo_nested_structures
test_cases.description: Undo/redo handles nested lists correctly

test_cases.name: UndoRedo_rapid_operations
test_cases.description: Rapid undo/redo (50+ operations) maintains fidelity
test_cases.expected_behavior: No dropped operations or corrupted state

tasks.impl_notes: TipTap has built-in undo manager. May need to integrate with Rust transaction log or replace with custom implementation for structural edit support.
